title: Saving plan sheet and chart

intro: Lesson 8: Achieving goals: saving for something that matters. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Goal £36, I save £5 a week. How long?

panels.title: Speeding up
points: Earn a little (chores agreed with parents)

keywords.def: an amount we aim to save for something
giving up something now for later

questions.q: Core: Saving plan sheet: choose a goal, price, weekly amount and timescale (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A complete plan with correct calculation.

questions.q: Extend: Show how cutting one weekly want shortens your plan.
questions.a: A recalculation with the extra saving.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why saving is better than buying now with a riba loan.
questions.a: No extra cost, no debt, and it avoids what Islam forbids.

questions.q: Goal £30, save £4 a week. Weeks needed?
questions.a: C) 8. 30 ÷ 4 = 7.5, so you need 8 whole weeks.

questions.q: Goal £20, save £5 a week. Weeks? A) 3 B) 4 C) 5
Big question: what helps you wait for a bigger reward?
questions.a: A clear plan, tracking progress, patience.
